summary: Scope UX overhaul + design-system foundation (phase 1 of UI pass)
description: Phase 1 of the look-and-feel upgrade (assessment 2026-07-10): establish the CSS design foundation (custom properties, hover/focus/transition primitives, readable type scale, SVG icons) and redesign the Corpus Scope section as the flagship. Fixes real UX defects: text-level checkboxes are currently fake (handleSave only persists tradition blocks; backend blocked_texts is fully plumbed — graph.ts filters on it), split save semantics (model/voice autosave vs scope explicit Save), div-checkboxes with no keyboard access, single-expand accordion. Adds the corpus spectrum bar signature element (tradition-hue segments weighted by chunk count, dimming as sources are blocked). Later phases migrate chat/nav/landing/history to the foundation. Nav label stays 'Scope'; Corpus Scope moves to the top of /settings so the label matches what you land on.

resolution.note: All 4 children closed: foundation (CSS vars + primitives + icons), corpus API (member ids + chunk weights), Scope redesign (blockedTexts persistence + autosave + spectrum bar + accessible rows), live chat footer. Later phases migrate nav/chat/landing/history to the foundation.
